KM.name: Prélèvement libératoire sur les plus-values immobilières des personnes physiques (20 %)
KM.statute: CGI 2022 (updated to 1 January 2022) art. 77 2°, 115 (LF 2024 OCR pp. 1-60 held; LF 2023 and 2025 not held)
KM.doc: art. 77 2°: gains made by individuals on built or unbuilt immovables acquired for value or free are property income; art. 115: those gains bear a final levy of 20 %, collected by the registration service when the deed is registered.
unsupported: the gain's computation rules (cost uplift, costs) were not read in the two-column extraction: gain = proceeds − cost − costs

KM.name: Impôt sur la propriété foncière (IPF)
KM.why: art. 192: fixed amounts per building by type — houses with outbuildings 5 000 FC (2 000 m² or more) / 3 000 FC, dwellings without outbuildings 1 000 FC, professional buildings and land by their own scales: the input carries neither the outbuildings nor the surface
